theorem frac_sep {q r r' b b' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hr' : 1 ≤ r')
    (hrq : Nat.Coprime r q) (hr'q : Nat.Coprime r' q) (hb : b < r) (hb' : b' < r')
    (hbr : Nat.Coprime r b) (hb'r : Nat.Coprime r' b') {A : ℤ}
    (hne : ¬ ((q : ℤ) ∣ A ∧ r = r' ∧ b = b')) (u : ℝ) :
    1 / ((q : ℝ) * r * r') - |u| ≤
      |(A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ) - round (A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ)| :=

note: Lean proves the large-sieve step with W−W′+1 in place of W/2 (smaller weight when W′ < W/2+1), for odd m; [H]'s W/2 version is not stated. Erratum: [H] applies MV73 (1.6), which needs an integer N at least the span of the primes in (W',W], with N = W/2; that span can be W/2+1/2 (W = 13: primes 7..13, span 7 > 6.5), and there the literal (1.6) weight 0.0986 is below [H]'s 0.1038. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_5_48.py`).
